product.label: In the product
product.title: AI people actually use
product.body: Not a demo bolted to the side. AI built into features people rely on, and held to the same standard as everything around it.

practice.label: In the work
practice.title: A faster way to build
practice.body: Agents in the daily loop: planning, writing, reviewing. The judgement stays human. The typing mostly doesn't.

page.label: In front of you
page.title: This page, for instance
page.body: Designed, written and committed by an AI agent from a brief and a conversation, then reviewed line by line. You are looking at the output.

craft.label: Full-stack
craft.title: The same care, whatever the shape.
craft.body: From the data model to the last pixel — web, mobile, and whatever else the product needs to become.

contact.title: Let's talk.
contact.body: Ideas, problems, roles, or just something you're building. LinkedIn is the fastest way to reach me.

egg.title: One more thing.
egg.body: You made it to the bottom. Now try being the model that has to guess who I am.
